description: One refused repeat shape per round, over the same drawn 2x2 rib cells: worked 0 times, overlapping, nested, two repeats to the end, past the edge of the row, and empty. Each round is written as needing a fix (never as its drawn cells) and is not counted.

rows.written: Round 1: (repeats need fixing: the repeat over cols 2-5 is worked 0 times; a repeat must be worked at least once)
Round 2: (repeats need fixing: the repeats over cols 2-4 and cols 4-6 overlap)
Round 3: (repeats need fixing: the repeat over cols 3-4 is inside the repeat over cols 1-6; a repeat inside a repeat is not supported yet)
Round 4: (repeats need fixing: the repeats over cols 2-3 and cols 5-6 are both worked to the end of the row; a row can have only one)
Round 5: (repeats need fixing: a repeat runs past the edge of the row (stored as 4..8 on a 6-column row))
Round 6: (repeats need fixing: a repeat covers no columns (stored as 2..2 on a 6-column row))
